detail.longDescription: I’m getting the following error in my JavaScript application: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'startTime') The problem is that I cannot find startTime anywhere in my own source code . I searched the entire project and there are no references to startTime . The error appears in the browser console, but I’m not sure what is causing it. Could this error be coming from: A third-party JavaScript library or dependency? A browser extension? A script injected by the browser or another tool? Some bundled/minified code? A framework or development tool? What is the best way to determine which script is trying to access startTime and identify the actual source of this error? The console shows: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'startTime') How can I trace this error back to the code that is generating it?
